name: RIBASIM_EXTERNAL_SECONDARY_STATE_V1
purpose: Define the smallest evidence-backed SWAP5+Ribasim application profile for which legacy secondary surface-water state ownership can eventually be disabled in SWAP.

fixed_level_supply.representation: LevelDemand lower target + bounded allocation-controlled supply route

automatic_target_selection.representation: transaction-safe coupler policy over accepted SWAP hydraulic scalars

automatic_target_band_realization.representation: Ribasim LevelDemand band + bounded allocation-controlled supply/discharge routes

signed_lower_exchange.representation: SWAP signed request -> Ribasim drainage/infiltration realization -> joint recomposition when availability changes realized transfer

surface_water_storage_geometry.mapping: Direct legacy STTAB storage-knot relabelling is structurally nonexact between knots. Q1H provides an epsilon-controlled continuous-area representation.
surface_water_storage_geometry.decision_needed: Production admission must freeze an accepted Q1H epsilon/error envelope or declare independently defined Ribasim-native geometry.

transfer_identities.representation: Coupler ledger preserves lower drainage, rapid drainage, top runoff, lower infiltration and top inundation identities across Ribasim aggregate balance endpoints.

extracted_signed_exchange.representation: Stateless signed extended drainage/infiltration candidate bound through serialized transaction runtime with exactly-once mass booking and rollback.

explicitly_excluded_until_separately_qua: nonlinear SWQHR1 exact parity for BETAW != 1
SWQHR2 exact legacy table/interpolation plus HBWEIR threshold parity
SWSRF=1 extended route with undefined/stale legacy WL dependency
any runoff/macropore/top-surface transfer class not explicitly mapped by Q3B when active
hard_configuration_guards: Internal F-CI52 surface-water state and EXTERNAL_RIBASIM may not own the same store.
No SWST committed state is allocated for the represented external-owned secondary store.
Ribasim-resolved WLP/WLS values are read-only hydraulic inputs to SWAP exchange physics.
No private SWAP copy of Ribasim storage or supply capacity may constrain infiltration in external-owner mode.
Every cross-model transfer must have one candidate identity and exactly-once opposite-sign accepted booking.
An excluded feature causes configuration rejection rather than fallback to an unqualified legacy branch.
A legacy STTAB->Ribasim Basin conversion may not be labeled exact merely because supplied storage knots are reproduced.
admission_blockers: production implementation and qualification of state-owner XOR
production binding of accepted external Ribasim water levels to the Q4B-qualified signed exchange variant
production freeze of Q1H storage-geometry epsilon/error envelope or explicit Ribasim-native geometry contract
end-to-end restart/retry/recomposition/mass qualification on current canonical
Ribasim model/core version provenance warning resolution
independent production qualification/admission on the eventual integration tree
relation_to_retirement: Research now supports coupled-state-ownership retirement for this bounded profile, but no production retirement authority exists until the separate admission gate closes.
